children: CIENA CORP reported third-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $1.67B and diluted EPS of $1.83, up sharply from the prior-year quarter as net income rose to $266.42M.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted net income per potential common share”.
Revenue growth was driven by strong product demand, with roughly 37% year-over-year growth in the quarter and ~36.6% YTD growth.
Channel and customer mix shifted toward cloud providers, with a few customers becoming larger contributors to revenue.
Notable product momentum in Optical Networking, including demand for the 6500 RLS, Waveserver platforms, coherent pluggables and the Waveserver ecosystem.
Operations scaling included historically high backlog, multi-year supplier and customer purchase agreements, and increased inventory procurement to secure supply.
R&D investment rose about 12% year-over-year in the quarter to support WaveLogic coherent modem enhancements and data-center/addressable market expansion.
